Setup
Red chose tails for the opening coin flip.
Blue won the coin toss.
Blue decided to go first.
Red drew 7 cards for the opening hand.
- 7 drawn cards.
   • Basic Fighting Energy, Basic Fighting Energy, Switch, Makuhita, Poké Pad, Premium Power Pro, Boss's Orders
Blue drew 7 cards for the opening hand.
- 7 drawn cards.
Blue took a mulligan.
- Cards revealed from Mulligan 1
   • Lillie's Determination, Night Stretcher, Toxtricity, Basic Darkness Energy, Punk Helmet, Basic Darkness Energy, Dusk Ball
Red drew 1 more card because Blue took at least 1 mulligan.
- Red drew Mega Lucario ex.
Red played Makuhita to the Active Spot.
Blue played Team Rocket's Sneasel to the Active Spot.

Blue's Turn
Blue drew a card.
Blue played Dusk Ball.
- Blue drew Toxtricity.
- Blue shuffled their deck.
Blue attached Punk Helmet to Team Rocket's Sneasel in the Active Spot.
Blue attached Basic Darkness Energy to Team Rocket's Sneasel in the Active Spot.
Blue ended their turn.

Red's Turn
Red drew Lillie's Determination.
Red played Poké Pad.
- Red drew Lunatone.
- Red shuffled their deck.
Red played Lunatone to the Bench.
Red played Lillie's Determination.
- Red shuffled 6 cards into their deck.
   • Basic Fighting Energy, Basic Fighting Energy, Switch, Premium Power Pro, Boss's Orders, Mega Lucario ex
- Red drew 8 cards.
   • Basic Fighting Energy, Solrock, Poké Pad, Mega Lucario ex, Ultra Ball, Switch, Special Red Card, Solrock
Red played Solrock to the Bench.
Red's Lunatone used Lunar Cycle.
- Red discarded Basic Fighting Energy.
- Red drew 3 cards.
   • Gravity Mountain, Boss's Orders, Mega Lucario ex
Red played Poké Pad.
- Red drew Riolu.
- Red shuffled their deck.
Red played Riolu to the Bench.
Red ended their turn.

Blue's Turn
Blue drew a card.
Blue played Lillie's Determination.
- Blue shuffled 5 cards into their deck.
- Blue drew 8 cards.
Blue played Buddy-Buddy Poffin.
- Blue drew 2 cards and played them to the Bench.
   • Scraggy, Toxel
- Blue shuffled their deck.
Blue attached Basic Darkness Energy to Scraggy on the Bench.
Blue's Team Rocket's Sneasel used Scratch on Red’s Makuhita for 20 damage.

Red's Turn
Red drew Makuhita.
Red evolved Riolu to Mega Lucario ex on the Bench.
Red played Makuhita to the Bench.
Red played Ultra Ball.
- Red discarded 2 cards.
   • Solrock, Gravity Mountain
- Red drew Meowth ex.
- Red shuffled their deck.
Red played Meowth ex to the Bench.
Red's Meowth ex used Last-Ditch Catch.
- Red drew Lillie's Determination.
- Red shuffled their deck.
Red played Switch.
- Red's Mega Lucario ex was switched with Red's Makuhita to become the Active Pokémon.
Red's Mega Lucario ex is now in the Active Spot.
Red played Lillie's Determination.
- Red shuffled 3 cards into their deck.
   • Mega Lucario ex, Special Red Card, Boss's Orders
- Red drew 8 cards.
   • Fighting Gong, Basic Fighting Energy, Boss's Orders, Lillie's Determination, Air Balloon, Secret Box, Premium Power Pro, Ultra Ball
Red's Lunatone used Lunar Cycle.
- Red discarded Basic Fighting Energy.
- Red drew 3 cards.
   • Basic Fighting Energy, Basic Fighting Energy, Special Red Card
Red attached Basic Fighting Energy to Mega Lucario ex in the Active Spot.
Red's Mega Lucario ex used Aura Jab on Blue’s Team Rocket's Sneasel for 130 damage.
- Red attached Basic Fighting Energy to Makuhita on the Bench.
- Red attached Basic Fighting Energy to Makuhita on the Bench.
Blue's Team Rocket's Sneasel was Knocked Out!
- 2 cards were discarded from Blue's Team Rocket's Sneasel.
   • Basic Darkness Energy, Punk Helmet
Punk Helmet was activated.
- Red put 4 damage counters on Blue's Mega Lucario ex.
Red took a Prize card.
Lunatone was added to Red's hand.
Blue's Scraggy is now in the Active Spot.

Blue's Turn
Blue drew a card.
Blue didn't take an action in time.

Red's Turn
Red drew Poké Pad.

   • Hariyama, Premium Power Pro, Riolu

- Red attached Basic Fighting Energy to Makuhita on the Bench.
Blue's Scraggy was Knocked Out!

Red took a Prize card.
Basic Fighting Energy was added to Red's hand.
Blue's Toxel is now in the Active Spot.

Blue's Turn
Blue drew a card.
Blue didn't take an action in time.

Red's Turn
Red drew Basic Fighting Energy.
Red's Mega Lucario ex used Aura Jab on Blue’s Toxel for 260 damage. Blue's Toxel took 130 more damage because of Fighting Weakness.
- Damage breakdown:
   • Base damage: 130 damage
   • Weakness to Fighting: 130 damage
   • Total damage: 260 damage

Blue's Toxel was Knocked Out!
Red took a Prize card.
Riolu was added to Red's hand.
No Benched Pokémon for backup. Red wins.
